August 18, 2026

According to this week's Economist / YouGov Poll, about one-third (35%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Donald Trump's job performance as president, and 61% disapprove. results.content: Washington, DC, February 22, 2026 – A new ABC News/Washington Post/Ipsos poll finds more Americans disapprove (64%) than approve (34%) of President Donald Trump’s handling of tariffs on imported goods. Trump’s approval rating on tariffs – as well as on his handling of inflation – lag behind his overall approval rating. Despite these negative ratings, Americans are split on who they trust to better handle reducing the cost of living: equal shares trust Trump (32%) and Democrats in Congress
